EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7

Reference No.: MTR/LND/ACQUI/L2/3919. I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose:

The blocks of land from 1 to 22 mentioned in the Preliminary Plan No. 2602, located in the Uyanwatta Grama Niladhari Division in the Matara Divisional Secretariat Division, Matara District, Southern Province have been acquired under Matara expedited town development programme for creation of the proposed forest garden and development activities thereabouts.
